title: Bounce and Breathe
style: world jazz, female lead vocal, kora and brass, walking bass, 88 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
Before every point.
Bounce the ball. Breathe.
Every language knows this moment.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Bounce the ball and find your ground
Slow your breath, hear the sound
Shoulders back, head up tall
You are ready for the call

[VERSE 2 - Somali transliteration]
Ku celi kubadda oo hel aasaaskaaga
Neefsashadaada gaabso, codka dhageyso
Garabaha dib u saar, madaxa sara u qaad
Waxaad diyaar u tahay wicitaanka

[VERSE 3 - Lithuanian transliteration]
Atsok kamuoli ir rask savo pagrinda
Suletek kvapavima, girdek garsa
Peciai atgal, galva aukstai
Esi pasiruoses atsakyti i kvietima

[CHORUS]
BOUNCE - BOUNCE - DHUFAR - ATSOKT
BREATHE IN - BREATHE OUT - HOLD YOUR LINE
BOUNCE AND BREATHE - EVERY POINT
READY STANCE - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Sinhala transliteration]
Bola thabanna, obata niwas ganna
Niswaasa minisuma karaganna, awa dhakinna
Ikkal pasu karana, oluwa usata thaba ganna
Oba wissaya padinne sarasennata

[VERSE 5 - Mongolian transliteration]
Bombyg lav, gazraa ol
Amysgalaa udaasga, duugaa son
Mur ruu hoysh, tolgoy deer
Uchir duudlagad belten baina

[VERSE 6 - Galician]
Bota a pelota e atopa o teu centro
Lentifica a respiracion, escoita o son
Ombros atras, cabeza alta
Estas listo para responder a chamada

[CHORUS]
BOUNCE - BOUNCE - DHUFAR - ATSOKT
BREATHE IN - BREATHE OUT - HOLD YOUR LINE
BOUNCE AND BREATHE - EVERY POINT
READY STANCE - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Somali. Lithuanian. Sinhala. Mongolian. Galician.
One bounce. One breath.
Every point. Every language.
You are ready.

[FINAL CHORUS]
BOUNCE - BOUNCE - DHUFAR - ATSOKT
BREATHE IN - BREATHE OUT - HOLD YOUR LINE
BOUNCE AND BREATHE - EVERY POINT
READY STANCE - EVERY TIME
ONE BOUNCE - ONE BREATH
HOLD THE LINE - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Bounce and breathe.
